usageNotes: Use this to check what APT package updates are pending on a remote PBS node — useful before scheduling maintenance or deciding whether to trigger an upgrade run. The remote node must be reachable and already registered in PDM; the caller needs Resource.Modify on the remote/node/system path. Results reflect the last APT cache refresh on the node, not a live apt-get update run — if the list looks stale, trigger an apt-get update on the node first.

examples.summary: List pending APT updates on node 'pbs1' of remote 'hetzner-pbs'

tips: Results are based on the node's local APT cache; if OldVersion equals Version the cache may be out of date.
Check the Origin field to distinguish Proxmox-signed packages from upstream Debian packages before applying updates.
The 'localhost' node alias is accepted when PDM itself is the PBS node.
